text_description: Full runway look in a vivid red and white vertical stripe motif, built as a coordinated long-sleeve top or jacket over a short matching skirt. The upper garment has a close, structured fit through the torso with a round neckline and a central front placket emphasized by layered red-and-white pointed leaf or flame-shaped appliqué running from collar to hem. The shoulders are narrow and the sleeves are slim and full length, continuing the vertical stripe pattern and ending in pointed scalloped cuffs that extend over the wrists. The bodice is detailed with horizontal pocket-like bands or flap details at the chest and waist, interrupting the stripes with crisp red outlines. At the waist/hip, the top breaks into a peplum-like hem of repeating pointed scallops; beneath it, a darker navy/black-and-white layer of similar pointed shapes is visible before the matching skirt begins. The skirt is very short, sitting above mid-thigh, with red-and-white vertical striping and a dense fringe-like hem made of overlapping pointed petal shapes that create a jagged, rhythmic edge. A coordinating red-and-white patterned head covering frames the face at the top of the image. The model carries dangling gold-toned chain straps in one hand, suggesting a small bag mostly out of frame. The overall effect is graphic, precise, and ornamental, with strong vertical striping contrasted by sharp scalloped appliqué edges.
